grammar.title: 主谓一致
grammar.explanation: 主语为单数概念时谓语用单数，复数概念用复数。注意集体名词、就近原则、就远原则等特殊情况。
grammar.structure: 主语 + 谓语（与主语数一致）

examples.sentence: The committee has/have reached a decision.
examples.note: 强调整体用单数，强调成员用复数

examples.sentence: Either the students or the teacher is responsible.
examples.translation: 要么学生，要么老师负责。

grammar.ieltsTip: 雅思写作中主谓一致错误是常见的失分点，写完后务必检查主谓数的一致性。

speaking.cueCard: Describe a challenge you faced and how you overcame it. You should say: what the challenge was / when it happened / how you dealt with it / and explain what you learned from the experience.
speaking.sampleAnswer: One of the most daunting challenges I've faced was delivering a presentation in English at an international conference during my third year of university. As a non-native speaker with limited public speaking experience, the prospect of addressing an audience of experts was genuinely terrifying. To prepare, I devoted countless hours to refining my slides, rehearsing my delivery in front of a mirror, and seeking feedback from professors and peers. On the day of the presentation, my hands were shaking, but I focused on my breathing and reminded myself that I had prepared thoroughly. To my surprise, the presentation went smoothly, and the Q&A session that followed was intellectually stimulating rather than intimidating. This experience taught me that preparation is the best antidote to anxiety, and that growth often lies just beyond our comfort zones.
speaking.tips: 讲述挑战时突出过程和心理变化，体现成长。
